values.title: House Between the Pines
values.text: A study in light, shelter, and the space between rooms.

values.caption: A conceptual project study, shown as an abstract illustration.

values.text:
## Built around a clearing

The plan gathers shared spaces around a protected outdoor room. A long roofline connects them while allowing the landscape to remain visible.

Materials are restrained: timber, pale mineral surfaces, and a dark protective edge.
